decisions.reason: The charting bundle is a low-cost extension of the core map.apps ecosystem and was likely folded into the standard bundle set rather than withdrawn, though its absence from the website since 2020 suggests reduced prominence.
This niche plugin was never prominently presented and has not appeared since 2018, so cutting it and folding its functionality into the main search offer frees maintenance effort.
VueTOC was an experimental mobile component that has disappeared from view and is likely superseded by responsive layer controls in newer map.apps releases, so it should be retired.

Platform providers' own field apps now cover mobile field data capture, so a proprietary product duplicating them offers little differentiation and its resources are better spent on integration services.
The search extension is closely tied to the established web map apps offer and addresses a recurring customer need, so it remains worth maintaining.
